concerns.text: FR-004 states that if the CLMM fails to converge the system must switch to a robust alternative such as an LMM with robust SEs or a non‑parametric bootstrap, while FR-005 requires using a Wilcoxon signed‑rank test (with Bonferroni correction) as the fallback. The two fallback methods are mutually exclusive, creating a contradictory requirement for the same failure condition.

Multiple functional requirements (e.g., FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008) contain cross‑references to "US-001", "US-002", and "US-003", but no user‑story identifiers with those names exist in the document; user stories are labeled "User Story 1", "User Story 2", etc. These undefined references break traceability.

The document mixes terminology: user stories are introduced as "User Story 1" etc., yet later requirements refer to them via "US-001" style IDs. This inconsistency can cause confusion and makes the cross‑references above invalid.
